newsitem.title: USA: TCF seeks conversion to bank charters.
newsitem.headline: TCF seeks conversion to bank charters.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said it submitted appliciations to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to convert its federal savings bank subsidiaries to national banks.

TCF currently has four savings bank subsidiaries with 194 locations. On November 14, it announced plans to expand its banking network into Colorado by opening full-service supermarket branches at Cub Foods stores.
TCF said it will file applications with federal regulators to charter new national banks in Ohio and Colorado.
In July, TCF received approval to create four national banks that would have operated within TCF savings bank locations in Minnesota, Illinois, Wisconsin and Michigan.
Under the new proposal, TCF will convert its existing federal savings banks to national banks rather than create new banks in those states.
